caption: The drawing is composed of a plain, light tan or beige background with several outlined rectangular shapes, each drawn with thin, straight black lines. There are three main rectangles labeled "C," "C-1," and "C-2." The rectangle labeled "C-2" is positioned horizontally near the bottom left, while "C" and "C-1" are positioned vertically near the top right and left, respectively, adjacent to each other. Along the left side of "C-2," the words "CENTER BACK" are written vertically. On the right edge of "C," the words "CENTER FRONT - CUT ON FOLD" are written vertically. Within the rectangle labeled "C-1," there are two small arrows or notches pointing inward from the longer sides and two parallel dashed lines near the top. Inside the rectangle labeled "C," there are similar notches and dashed lines. Above the bottom right corner of "C-2," there is a block of handwritten text explaining the use and assembly instructions of these pieces, including a small drawing of evenly spaced, vertical zigzag lines above the text block, which may represent pleats. The instructional text describes how the pieces form a skirt and provides instructions for pleating and assembling the sections. The font is a clear, hand-lettered style.
title: Descripiton of a Wedding Dress
